title: Cryzo 10
visualIntent: The Cryzo playful-editorial pet lane: fashion-forward, expressive, premium, and character-rich without becoming childish.

compositionRecipes.label: Cryzo 10 default
compositionRecipes.whenToUse: Use this as the default build recipe whenever Cryzo 10 is the locked primary reference.
compositionRecipes.heroStructure: Build a poster-field hero with one dominant surreal pet-fashion image, a hard color block, and giant condensed type that overlaps the subject instead of sitting in a safe adjacent column.
sectionOrder: Poster hero with giant headline, hard color field, and one surreal pet-fashion image.
Manifesto or attitude chapter using sparse copy and confrontational scale shifts.
Collection, drop, or styling section framed like a fashion spread rather than a store grid.
Editorial story or culture chapter with asymmetric imagery and serif interruption.
Commanding CTA close that still feels like a poster panel, not a generic footer CTA.
compositionRecipes.headlineImageRelationship: Place the oversized headline in front of or directly over the hero subject so the type and image visibly compete; the subject should remain legible behind the typography instead of being isolated in a separate panel.
layeringRules: Keep the hero subject partially behind the giant display type or inside a hard poster field instead of isolated in a clean adjacent panel.
Let color fields, image planes, and typography create visible depth even before motion is applied.
Use one dominant foreground relationship and one subordinate supporting layer; do not stack decorative layers without purpose.
Every overlap, crop, or z-index shift should strengthen the selected reference rather than adding generic drama.
compositionRecipes.typeScaleRelationship: Use at least one oversized moment that sets the emotional scale before explanatory content arrives.
compositionRecipes.paletteDistribution: Palette dominance should use one or two assertive brand colors as intentional fields rather than generic accent sprinkles.
compositionRecipes.imageFraming: Imagery should feel character-led, art-directed, and specific to the selected pet-fashion or pet-brand tone.
compositionRecipes.asymmetry: Allow tension, crop pressure, and asymmetry when it preserves the reference family.
compositionRecipes.ctaPosture: Make CTAs feel native to the reference family instead of generic bright buttons.

antiPatterns: Do not tidy the composition into a normal centered hero with balanced cards.
Do not soften the palette into tasteful beige-neutral premium branding.
Do not replace fashion-editorial pet imagery with cute consumer pet-shop visuals.
Do not flatten the type into one safe sans-serif system with predictable line lengths.
allowedVariation: Content, brand naming, and product specifics may change freely as long as the composition DNA remains recognizably native to the selected reference family.
You may vary the exact crop, chapter sequencing, or copy cadence, but the page must stay visibly editorial and reference-led.
Do not use variety as an excuse to fall back to generic AI-generated landing-page patterns.

exemplarCues.label: Poster overlap hero
cues: Oversized condensed headline sits in front of the subject.
Hero subject remains readable behind typography instead of living in a detached panel.
Hard color fields and image planes create immediate poster tension.

exemplarCues.label: Editorial chapter rhythm
cues: Use hard section breaks and chapter-like pacing rather than feature-card repetition.
Let at least one section feel sparse and attitude-led instead of explanatory.
